author: reek
body: This is the smallest test in the battery and it is the one that closes the actual cause. `OAuthClient` had never compiled, and the reason nobody knew is that its only citers were `OAuthProvider` and `ExternalAuthBridge`, and NOTHING cited those: a dead island of three chapters, reachable from no battery run, free to rot. Fixing the compile error without giving them a citer would have left them exactly as unreachable as before, and the next defect would have gone the same way.

author: reek
body: So this file's job is to be cited BY the battery and to cite THEM. It asserts almost nothing about behaviour on purpose -- the behaviour is not what was broken, and a thin assertion is honest about that where an elaborate one would imply a coverage that does not exist. One value is read from each chapter so the cite cannot be dead-code-eliminated into a no-op.

author: reek
body: What it does prove, every battery run: these three chapters still compile, `uri-encode` still resolves for the one that calls it, and nobody has re-broken the citation graph.
